title: SRFTI Panel to Submit Campus Violence Report by November 27 Amid Ongoing Protests

ai.summary: SRFTI students have been protesting since September 27 after alleged campus violence, with a fact-finding committee expected to submit a report on the September 27 incident by November 27, 2026.

facts.claim: SRFTI students have been protesting since September 27 after alleged campus violence
facts.quote: The Kolkata-based premier film institute has been witnessing ongoing student protests since September 27 following alleged attacks on students at the Main Theatre during an event organised by the RSS-affiliated Akhil Bharatiya Grahak Panchayat.

facts.claim: a fact-finding committee expected to submit a report on the September 27 incident by November 27, 2026
facts.quote: The Fact-Finding Committee is actively engaged in its work. The volume of material, records and other evidence requiring examination is substantial, and the Committee is undertaking a detailed and rigorous exercise to ensure that all relevant aspects are duly considered.
